headline: Cape and Mooring Hold the Line; Marban Shifts, Lykos Stirs
war_summary: Heavy fire continues at Callum's Cape and Mooring County. The Cape logs forty-six actions in the day and two in the past watch, its works divided three Colonial, three Warden and one unclaimed. Mooring County follows with thirty-five in the day and six in the past two hours, the Wardens holding ten works to two. Linn Mercy stays hot with fourteen actions in six hours; the lines there stand seven Colonial, three Warden and one unclaimed. The sharpest change since the last edition is Marban Hollow, where Warden colours have advanced: that front now reads three works apiece with two unclaimed, against five Colonial and two Warden earlier. Weathered Expanse burns on, six actions this watch and twenty-four in the day, its count six Warden, one Colonial and two unclaimed. Lykos Isle, silent at the last report, has woken with five actions in two hours and nine across the day. Stonecradle, Nevish Line and Godcrofts have gone quiet, their latest actions hours old.
